$schemaNote: DESIGN / CONFIG EXAMPLE ONLY. The current runtime (src/client-profile.js, src/oauth.js) does NOT read this file. Encoding this JSON does not change any behavior. See docs/OPEN-SOURCE/CLIENT-PROFILES.md.
displayName: Claude (claude.ai web connectors / Claude Desktop remote)

resultEncoding.note: TEXT results are enough; structuredContent is optional and disabled by default here. Matches CLIENT_PROFILES[claude]. Keep tool results under the hosted ~150,000 character cap (gateway truncates at 8000).

annotationsDefault.note: Claude REQUIRES both readOnlyHint and destructiveHint declared on every tool. sanitizeTool already emits the three hints; src/client-profile.js keeps them identical across profiles. These values are the declared defaults, not a new behavior.

oauth.flow: OAuth 2.0 with DCR or CIMD by default; user-entered client id/secret or Anthropic-held creds also supported

callbackAllowlist.note: This is the redirect used when the user manually enters a client id/secret. IMPORTANT: src/oauth.js does NOT currently list this host in isAllowedRedirectUri() - allowing it would require a code/config change. This entry is a documented design target only. DCR/CIMD paths do not use this callback.

constraints: 401 response must carry WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="...".
Only the first authorization_servers entry is consumed.
Public clients rotate refresh tokens (the gateway currently does NOT rotate - a known gap, see limitations).
Discovery/register/token endpoints must respond within 10s; refresh within 30s; token endpoint form-urlencoded.

toolSurface.schema: All tools must declare readOnlyHint + destructiveHint; no documented tool-count cap.

knownLimitations: Auth settings cannot be edited after saving a connector - remove and re-add.
Hosted tool result cap ~150,000 characters (Claude Code: 25k tokens / 16 MiB); tool call timeout 240s.
Public internet, HTTPS 443 only, IPv4 egress from 160.79.104.0/21; private/CGNAT URLs rejected.
Static header credential mode is beta/limited and out of scope here.
Gateway refresh tokens are non-rotating - conflicts with Claude's public-client expectation; must be validated before claiming support.
claude.ai callback is NOT in the current OAuth allowlist - manual client id/secret setup will fail until that is addressed.
unverified: No live end-to-end connection against this gateway has been performed; source is the first-party docs surveyed in docs/OPEN-SOURCE/WEB-CLIENTS.md (grabbed 2026-11-23).
Claude Desktop remote uses the same account-level connector path, but has not been tested here.
